en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
And may the peace, blessings, and prayers of Allah be upon our Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and all his companions.
translit: Wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ʿalā Nabiyyinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn.
Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī, waḥlul ʿuqdatam-mil-lisānī, yafqahū qawlī.

en: O Allah, teach us what benefits us, benefit us with what You have taught us, and increase us in knowledge.
translit: Allāhumma ʿallimnā mā yanfaʿunā wanfaʿnā bimā ʿallamtanā wa zidnā ʿilmā.

text: Last week we left off with the story of how [[Allah|الله]] [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] destroyed [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his forces when they came from [[Yemen|اليمن]] to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] to destroy the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], and how [[Allah|الله]] [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] destroyed [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and destroyed his army, and protected His house, the house of [[Allah|الله]] [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].

And we mentioned that [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] was the ruler of [[Yemen|اليمن]], but actually he was a Habashi, he was from what is known in modern times as Ethiopia. And we spoke about how the Ethiopians, how the [[Ahabash|أحباش]] took control of [[Yemen|اليمن]].

And [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] was the ruler of [[Yemen|اليمن]] at that time. But when he left to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], when he left with his army towards [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] with the intention of destroying the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], he left his son [[Yaksum|يكسوم]], [[Yaksum|يكسوم]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] in charge of [[Yemen|اليمن]].

So even after [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his army that he had taken with him to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], even after they were killed and they were destroyed, the country of [[Yemen|اليمن]] or the land of [[Yemen|اليمن]], it still remained under the rule of the [[Ahabash|أحباش]]. It still remained under the rule of the Ethiopians, with the son of [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]], [[Yaksum|يكسوم]], being in command.

And when [[Yaksum|يكسوم]] died, his brother, the brother of [[Yaksum|يكسوم]], his name was [[Masruq|مسروق]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]], he took control of the kingdom. So the family of [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]], or the son of [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]], was still ruling the kingdom of [[Yemen|اليمن]].

And at that time, during the time of [[Masruq|مسروق]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]], there was a young man, his name was [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]], and he was from the original royal family of [[Yemen|اليمن]]. He was from the family of [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربيعة بن نصر]], who we spoke about before.

And he was from the family of the [[Tubba|تبع]], the original Yemenis who ruled [[Yemen|اليمن]]. So he had royal blood in him, he was from the royal family and he was a pure Yemeni, and his name was [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]].

And of course, you know, him seeing his country and his people occupied by these [[Ahabash|أحباش]], by these Ethiopians, he and his people, the Yemenis, they don't have any say in what goes on in their own country, and they have to watch these foreigners rule their land and make their laws and make their rules, and they have to be subservient to them.

So [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]], he was very, very upset with the situation, and he wished to find a way to get the control of [[Yemen|اليمن]] back to the Yemenis, and preferably himself, because he was from the original royal family of [[Yemen|اليمن]]. So he wanted to think of a way: how can we take the power back from these [[Ahabash|أحباش]], from these Ethiopians who have occupied our land?

So he was able to gather some support from the Arabs, but not nearly enough to overthrow the government of [[Masruq|مسروق]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]]. There was no way that he could face the army of [[Masruq|مسروق]]. And he knew that, he knew that, 'No, this is not even a battle that's worth fighting. I have some support with the Arabs, but there's no way that we can face [[Masruq|مسروق]] and his army.'

So he thought, 'Okay, who else can I ask for help? Who is more powerful than the army of the [[Ahabash|أحباش]]? I need to find a leader or a ruler who is stronger than these [[Ahabash|أحباش]]. And if I can get them to help me, then we can take over this land once again.'

So he took a trip to [[Sham|شام]]. He went over to [[Sham|شام]], the Greater Syria area, where he met with the [[Qaysar|قيصر]]. And the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] was in [[Sham|شام]]. And he asked the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] for help. He said, 'You know, these [[Ahabash|أحباش]], they took over the land of my forefathers, and they occupied our land, and they're still ruling our land. I want to get what is rightfully mine, I want to get the land of [[Yemen|اليمن]] back to control of the Yemenis.'

But the [[Qaysar|قيصر]], he didn't want to hear any of it. Because if you remember, the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] was actually the one who sent a letter to the [[Najashi|نجاشي]] in [[Habashah|حباشة]] to go over to [[Yemen|اليمن]] and fight the Yemenis. This was actually from an order from the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] himself.

Because we talked about what happened in [[Yemen|اليمن]], and how [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]], who was the son of the [[Tubba|تبع]] and he was a Yemeni, how he killed the Christians in [[Yemen|اليمن]] by digging trenches and throwing them into those trenches of fire. And when the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] heard of this, and the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] was a Christian, the [[Qaysar|قيصر]], he sent a letter to the [[Najashi|نجاشي]] of [[Habashah|حباشة]] to send an army to [[Yemen|اليمن]] to get revenge on [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]]. And that's what they did.

And that is how the Habashis took control of [[Yemen|اليمن]] in the first place, by this order from the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] to the [[Najashi|نجاشي]]. So now, when [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]], he goes back to the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] and asks for help to get our, to get his land back, then of course the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] is not going to help him.

Because the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] is the one who sent the [[Ahabash|أحباش]] to [[Yemen|اليمن]] in the first place by ordering the [[Najashi|نجاشي]], or by requesting the [[Najashi|نجاشي]] to send his army to [[Yemen|اليمن]]. So the [[Qaysar|قيصر]] didn't want to hear anything from [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]]. And he didn't help him at all, and he didn't give him anything.

So now [[Sayf|سيف]] is upset, and he's thinking, 'You know, what can I do? I need to do something to get the land of my forefathers back.' So he thought at that time, 'Look, the [[Qaysar|قيصر]], he didn't help me. The best bet I have is to seek help from someone who is from the Arabs. I'm not going to seek help from the non-Arabs, I will go to an Arab and seek help from him.'

So he went to Iraq. He went to Iraq and the king there at that time, he was a man named [[Numan ibn al-Mundhir|نعمان بن المنذر]]. [[Numan ibn al-Mundhir|نعمان بن المنذر]], and he was the king, and he was a big king there in Iraq, and he was originally Yemeni as well. He was originally Yemeni, but he was settled there in Iraq and he became a king there in Iraq.

So when [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]] went to [[Numan ibn al-Mundhir|نعمان بن المنذر]] in Iraq and asked him for help to get the land of [[Yemen|اليمن]] back under Yemeni control, [[Numan ibn al-Mundhir|نعمان بن المنذر]], he understood the plight of [[Sayf|سيف]]. And he said, 'You know, I understand your situation, and I'm not unwilling to help you. I would help you if I could help you, but you know that army of the [[Ahabash|أحباش]], that Habashi army, it's a really strong and it's a really big army.'

'And you know, my army and my people, it's not strong enough to confront that army. I know my limit, I know my power, I know the power of my army, and there's no way that we would be able to defeat that army. But I have a suggestion for you.'

'If you just stay with me for a little while, every year I take a trip to visit the [[Kisra|كسرى]]. The [[Kisra|كسرى]], that's the leader of Persia, the leader of the Persian Empire.' He said, 'Every year, I and a group of my people, we take a trip to visit the [[Kisra|كسرى]]. If you want to stay until that time with me, you can stay, and then we will go together to the [[Kisra|كسرى]] and you can ask him for help.'

'And the [[Kisra|كسرى]], he was the most powerful man in the world, and his army was the most powerful army in the world. That was the superpower of that time.' So this is what [[Numan ibn al-Mundhir|نعمان بن المنذر]] suggested to [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]]: 'Just stay with me here. When the time comes for us to go and visit the [[Kisra|كسرى]], which we do every year, you come along with me, you meet him, you talk to him, you explain to him your situation.'

'Maybe he will offer to help you, and if he helps you, that army can easily destroy the army of the [[Ahabash|أحباش]].' So [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]], he thinks that this is a good idea. This is a smart plan. 'So let me stay here in Iraq, and when [[Numan|نعمان]] is going to visit the [[Kisra|كسرى]], I will go with him and I will explain my situation to the [[Kisra|كسرى]] himself.'

So when that time came for [[Numan ibn al-Mundhir|نعمان بن المنذر]] to go and visit the [[Kisra|كسرى]], [[Sayf|سيف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Dhi Yazan|ذو يزن]] accompanied him, and they went to the palace of the [[Kisra|كسرى]]. Now like we said, the [[Kisra|كسرى]] was the most powerful man in the world at that time, and his kingdom was the biggest and most powerful kingdom of that era.
So he was very, very well respected and feared, even by other kings. Other kings didn't consider him...
